config.label: Project ingest/admin API key minted in the Mushi console (Settings → API Keys)
config.description: Project ingest/admin API key minted in the Mushi console (Settings → API Keys). Scope mcp:read for triage, mcp:write to dispatch fixes.

config.label: Project UUID the key belongs to
config.description: Project UUID the key belongs to. Optional for single-project account keys.

config.label: Override the API base URL (self-hosted deployments)
config.description: Override the API base URL (self-hosted deployments). Defaults to the hosted Mushi Cloud endpoint.

config.label: Tool set to expose
config.description: Tool set to expose. Recommended: vibe (12 tools: triage, plain-English diagnosis, fix context, setup, docs). Add fixes (vibe,fixes) to dispatch fixes to cloud agents; all lists every tool. Unset keeps the earlier groups (triage,fixes,inventory,setup,docs).
